title: Debiasing Methods for Fairer Neural Models in Vision and Language Research: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying evaluation metrics such as Direct Bias (DB) for word embeddings, Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT), and utilizing gender classifiers to measure generated image distributions (e.g., on CelebA).

Surveying evaluation approaches including the use of vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) and human annotations to check representation disparities and stereotypical correlations in generated images and text.
Reviewed as a standard protected attribute evaluated via statistical group fairness metrics such as Demographic Parity, Equality of Opportunity, and Equality of Odds in classification tasks.
